evidence_explanation: In Report P, execution was on bar i close and step was i += 24. In Report P2 and P2.1, execution was on bar i+1 open and step was entry_bar_idx + 24 (i+25), shifting subsequent entries by 1 bar and causing 6 overlapping entries to be skipped.
In Report P, win was evaluated without execution slippage on bar i close touch. In Report P2, executed pricing on bar i+1 open altered trade boundaries and win was evaluated on Net PnL > 0.
Report P reported per-ounce cash delta (-$78.30) without multiplying by 100 oz contract size. Multiplying by 100 oz and accounting for 156 trades with $59 friction yields -$4,499.73.

Report P2 calculated MDD using np.maximum.accumulate without prepending 0.0. Since trade 1 was a loss of -$164.07, the drop from initial 0 was excluded from peak accumulation. Prepending 0.0 yields standard financial MDD of $4,619.32.
